entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We went through all sortsa options[n]on our way here, but...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Looks like we got no choice but to ask[n]for Alibaba's help.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Question is, how do we get in touch[n]with him?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: He cut off all contact with us after that[n]misunderstanding.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Then again, if we manage to steal[n]Futaba's heart, he may attempt to[n]reach out to us once more.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But we don't have any clues on what[n]her keywords are.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit, Alibaba! Where the hell[n]are you!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Actually, he may be closer than we think.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hypothetically speaking, even if we stole[n]Futaba's heart...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: How would Alibaba know that the deed[n]has been done?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Would he truly be able to discern that[n]just from cell phone messages?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You mean he'd have to meet her[n]in person?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Alibaba was able to deliver the calling[n]card here. On top of that, he can check[n]on Futaba's condition.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: However, according to the circumstances[n]he put forth, he's unable to meet with us.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This leads me to believe that it would be[n]bad for him if we were to see the two of[n]them together.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It seems to me...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Alibaba may in fact be Futaba herself.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So she's asking that we steal her[n]own heart?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Maybe she wants us to save her from[n]the scars of her abuse? That would be[n]hard to ask directly.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'd like to meet with Boss... He lives[n]nearby, right?
I know where his house is.
Will this be okay?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I won't ask anything that will get you[n]thrown out.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I agree. It's real late though. What're we[n]gonna tell Boss when we get there?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We'll say this take-out sushi is a gift[n]for him.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But my fatty tuna...!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No complaining.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's all go together.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Boss may get the wrong idea if[n][fName]-kun and I show up[n]alone.
